# 2 Chronicles 9 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 9 (31 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.2
- **EMET:** "And-he-told to-her Solomon all her-words and-not was-hidden a-thing from Solomon that not he-told to-her."
- **LOGOS:** "And Solomon answered all her questions. There was nothing hidden from Solomon that he could not explain to her."
- **PNEUMA:** "Solomon answered every question she had. Nothing was too difficult for him to explain."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.
